### Fixed
- **The model pods pass the fleet's restricted Pod Security Standard, and the chart adds no container to them** (giantswarm/agent-platform#518; proof 1 of giantswarm/giantswarm#37639). The connectivity chart's `model-serving` pods policy injected `hf-cache-init` into every model pod — root, `CHOWN`/`DAC_OVERRIDE`/`FOWNER` added, `chmod 0777` of the cache subdirectory — and the fleet's Kyverno set denied the pod on two rules the chart's `PolicyException` does not name (`disallow-capabilities-strict/adding-capabilities-strict`, `require-run-as-non-root-user/run-as-non-root-user`): on gazelle (4.28.14) the `LLMInferenceService`'s ReplicaSet was refused on every attempt (`validate.kyverno.svc-fail`, `ReplicaFailure=True`), no pod, no node, nothing served — the first time the container reached admission at all (#506 made the rule match these pods, #514 made it idempotent). The init container is **removed**, neither excepted nor made rootless: the `redirect-model-storage-*` rules give the pod the claim's `fsGroup` next to the claim mount (`modelServing.cache.fsGroup`, default 1000 — the uid and fsGroup model-manager's cache pods use; a pod that declared another fsGroup gets the claim's, one claim, one group), and the kubelet does the rest — it makes the claim's contents group-owned, group-writable and setgid on every mount (the CSI driver's `fsGroupPolicy` permitting: EBS gp3 and Azure Disk apply it) and creates a missing `subPath` directory with the claim root's mode and group, so `<claim>/<model>` is `root:1000 2775` and the storage-initializer (uid 1000), the runtime and model-manager's download Job (uid 1000, fsGroup 1000) write it, `mkdir -m 0777 -p` it and `rm -rf` it without root or a capability (the kubelet's exact sequence replayed in a container; without the fsGroup uid 1000 is denied, which is what the init container had papered over). `modelServing.policies.cacheInit` (image, resources) is gone. The chart's `PolicyException` is unchanged: it names the four rules the vLLM image and the storage-initializer violate, and nothing the chart adds needs one. `make verify-model-serving-policies` applies the fleet's five restricted-PSS ClusterPolicies (`tests/fixtures/restricted-pss-clusterpolicies.yaml`: kyverno-policies 3.7.2 as installed on a management cluster, every rule `Enforce`) with the chart's exception over the mutated pod of both shapes and holds every rule to pass or skip (the four excepted rules skip, `adding-capabilities-strict` and `run-as-non-root-user` pass), the bare pod to fail exactly the four excepted rules, and a pod with the 4.28.14 init container to fail exactly the two that denied it on gazelle; it holds the mutated pod's `fsGroup` and that the mutation adds no container. The live half — the workload pod admitted on the first ReplicaSet attempt and the predictor Ready — is the proof's.
